# skiResultsR ![](reference/figures/logo.png)

> Extract and analyze ski race results from skiresults.co.uk HTML files

`skiResultsR` provides a comprehensive set of functions for extracting
structured data from ski race result HTML files generated by
skiresults.co.uk. Convert race data into clean data frames for analysis,
visualization, and reporting.

## Features

- **🎿 Complete Event Extraction** - Extract all event data with a
  single function call
- **🏁 Race Analysis** - Get individual race results with cleaned times
  and rankings  
- **👥 Racer Information** - Extract participant details with profile
  links and club affiliations ()
- **🏆 Points Data** - Analyze points across different categories and
  competitions
- **📊 Clean Data Structures** - Consistent data frames ready for
  analysis
- **🔗 Preserve Links** - Maintain hyperlinks to racer profiles and club
  pages

## Installation

``` r
# Install from CRAN (when available)
install.packages("skiResultsR")

# Or install development version from GitHub
devtools::install_github("yourusername/skiResultsR")
```

## Quick Start

``` r
library(skiResultsR)

# Get path to sample data
file_path <- system.file("extdata", "chatham_oct2023.html", package = "skiResultsR")

# Extract complete event data
event_data <- get_event(file_path)

# View event summary
print(event_data$event_summary$title)
#> [1] "Chatham Ski Slope: LSERSA (07 October 2023)"

# View available races
names(event_data$races)
#> [1] "race-9973" "race-9981" "race-9974" "race-9975" "race-9976"

# Get racers
head(event_data$racers)
#>        name                              href club club_href
#> 1 BUNTON Ryan https://skiresults.co.uk/people/30 <NA>      <NA>
#> 2  BROWN Ben  https://skiresults.co.uk/people/23 <NA>      <NA>
```

## Main Functions

### Primary Functions

| Function                                                                              | Purpose                          | Returns                  |
|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------|--------------------------|
| [`get_event()`](https://justinjtownsend.github.io/skiResultsR/reference/get_event.md) | Extract complete event data      | List with all components |
| [`get_races()`](https://justinjtownsend.github.io/skiResultsR/reference/get_races.md) | Extract all race tables          | List of race data frames |
| [`get_race()`](https://justinjtownsend.github.io/skiResultsR/reference/get_race.md)   | Extract specific race by ID/type | Single race data frame   |

### Helper Functions

| Function                                                                                              | Purpose                          | Returns    |
|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------|------------|
| [`get_racers()`](https://justinjtownsend.github.io/skiResultsR/reference/get_racers.md)               | Extract unique racers with links | Data frame |
| `get_race_points()`                                                                                   | Extract points across categories | Data frame |
| [`get_event_summary()`](https://justinjtownsend.github.io/skiResultsR/reference/get_event_summary.md) | Extract event metadata           | List       |

## Usage Examples

### Get Event Summary

``` r
# Quick event overview
summary <- get_event_summary(file_path)
cat("Event:", summary$title)
cat("Date:", summary$date)
cat("Venue:", summary$slope)
```

### Analyze Race Performance

``` r
# Get a specific race
race_data <- get_race(file_path, "race-9973")

# View race statistics
if ("time_cleaned" %in% names(race_data)) {
  times <- race_data$time_cleaned[!is.na(race_data$time_cleaned)]
  cat("Fastest time:", min(times), "seconds")
  cat("Average time:", mean(times), "seconds")
}
```

### Extract Points Data

``` r
# Get points across all categories
points <- get_race_points(file_path)

# Analyze by category
table(points$points_category)
aggregate(points ~ points_category, data = points, FUN = mean)
```

## Data Structure

The package returns consistent, well-structured data:

``` r
event_data <- get_event(file_path)
str(event_data, max.level = 1)
#> List of 5
#>  $ event_summary: List of 8
#>  $ races        : List of 5
#>  $ racers       : 'data.frame': 150 obs. of 4 variables
#>  $ race_points  : 'data.frame': 0 obs. of 7 variables  
#>  $ clubs        : 'data.frame': 0 obs. of 2 variables
```

## Sample Data

The package includes sample HTML files for testing and examples:

- `chatham_oct2023.html` - Chatham Ski Slope event from October 2023
- `brentwood_jun2023.html` - Brentwood Park event from June 2023

``` r
# List available sample files
list.files(system.file("extdata", package = "skiResultsR"))
```

  (recommended for analysis)

  (recommended for plotting)

# Package index

## Event Functions

Functions for extracting complete event information

- [`get_event()`](https://justinjtownsend.github.io/skiResultsR/reference/get_event.md)
  : Extract all event information from an HTML file
- [`get_event_dtls()`](https://justinjtownsend.github.io/skiResultsR/reference/get_event_dtls.md)
  : Extract event details from an HTML file
- [`get_event_summary()`](https://justinjtownsend.github.io/skiResultsR/reference/get_event_summary.md)
  : Extract event metadata from an HTML file

## Race Functions

Functions for extracting race data and results

- [`get_races()`](https://justinjtownsend.github.io/skiResultsR/reference/get_races.md)
  : Extract all race tables from an event HTML file
- [`get_race()`](https://justinjtownsend.github.io/skiResultsR/reference/get_race.md)
  : Extract a specific race table by race ID from an event HTML file
- [`get_race_types()`](https://justinjtownsend.github.io/skiResultsR/reference/get_race_types.md)
  : Extract race types and event information from an HTML file

## Data Extraction Functions

Functions for extracting specific data types from races

- [`get_racers()`](https://justinjtownsend.github.io/skiResultsR/reference/get_racers.md)
  : Extract all registered racers from an event HTML file
- [`get_points()`](https://justinjtownsend.github.io/skiResultsR/reference/get_points.md)
  : Extract points data for a specific race
- [`get_clubs()`](https://justinjtownsend.github.io/skiResultsR/reference/get_clubs.md)
  : Extract all clubs from an event HTML file
